name: 女邪神 努维娅
desc: 被召唤的场合，这张卡破坏。对方即使控制着1只怪兽的场合，攻击力下降对方场上的怪兽每1只200。
faq: If "Light of Intervention" is on the field this card cannot be Set and if Normal Summoned in face-up Defense Position it will be destroyed.
ruling: If “Skill Drain” is active when “Nuvia the Wicked” is Normal Summoned, “Nuvia the Wicked” will not be destroyed. If “Skill Drain” leaves the field or is negated after “Nuvia the Wicked” has been Normal Summoned, “Nuvia the Wicked” is not destroyed.
